capabilities: List notes connected by few links with a configurable threshold
Convert plain-text unlinked mentions into wikilinks from the dashboard
Identify orphan notes with zero links
Show a graph health score ring and status-bar counts
Filter scans by ignored folders, excluded titles, and mention length
disambiguation: Not a broken-URL or dead-link checker; it audits graph connectivity — weak links, orphans, and unlinked mentions.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation is manual via release files into the plugins folder.
intentEvidence: Dataview can tell you what links exist, but it can't tell you the quality of your graph.
problem: Obsidian shows which links exist but gives no view of graph quality, so weakly connected notes and unlinked mentions stay hidden.

relations.evidence: Dataview can tell you what links exist, but it can't tell you the quality of your graph.

summary: Dashboard plugin that audits vault link quality, surfacing weakly connected notes, unlinked mentions, orphans, and a graph health score.
